pedigree.songTitle: I Bet You Think About Me (Taylor’s Version) [From the Vault]
pedigree.line: And the girl in your bed has a fine pedigree
pedigree.section_label: From the Vault] LyricsIn “I Bet You Think About Me,” Taylor confronts her ex now that she was able to move on, knowing he still hasn’t. Using an angry and disappointed tone, Taylor puts the blame on her lover for leaving for… [Verse 1
stanza: 3 AM and I'm still awake, I'll bet you're just fine
Fast asleep in your city that's better than mine
And the girl in your bed has a fine pedigree
And I'll bet your friends tell you she's better than me, huh
